channel.title: Typefield Updates
channel.description: Signed public beta updates for Typefield.

item.title: Typefield 0.59.27
item.description:
Library responsiveness and background-work refinement:
- Reuse Library sidebar counts, matching styles and exact preview measurements during search, selection and scrolling. - Preserve body specimen text selection and layout when unrelated inspector controls change. - Keep Font Health scans off the UI thread, support cancellation and reject stale background results. - Preserve recursive folder-change detection while cancelling obsolete scans. - Retain the completed Spaces cursor/image and Letterform toolbar/proof/canvas refinements.
Native, window, Figma and focused performance checks are recorded in the repository QA report. Timings are specific path measurements, not a universal frame-rate claim.
Apple silicon, macOS 13 or later. Ad hoc signed public beta; not Developer ID notarized.
DMG SHA-256: `a87e2a7bbb6e0d178cab1db16f5ccfe814e8d97696a9d0151fa152de1912dd6d`

item.title: Typefield 0.59.26
item.description:
Letterform tools now have larger, fixed hitboxes and visible shortcuts: Select (V), Nodes (A), Pen (P), Line (L), Rectangle (R), Ellipse (O), and Hand (H). Paths and Transform sit together beside the drawing tools, and the Word Proof disclosure is beside its title.
Tool switching preserves the canvas position and restores keyboard focus. Word Proof rebuilds only the visible letters when geometry changes; dense outlines reuse bounded drawing and hit-test caches. Anchor/curve edits, live fill/proof, undo, and saved geometry remain intact.
Includes the completed Spaces cursor-picker and image-resizing refinement, plus signed in-app updates. Apple silicon, macOS 13 or later.

item.title: Typefield 0.59.25
item.description:
Spaces cursor and image refinement:
- A named active cursor selector with Auto by default and quick mode choices. - Labeled Text, Shape and Image add controls beside the existing inspector panels. - Imported images are selected immediately and support proportional corner resizing; Shift stretches freely. - Image selection survives canvas switches, copied images retain appearance controls, and deletion releases embedded image data.
Native, window, Figma and disposable live interaction checks passed.
Apple silicon, macOS 13 or later. Ad hoc signed beta, not Developer ID notarized.
DMG SHA-256: `706f23eee00553797a4fc72b7f9d565a9154aa6bcae0bc0bb5d0228921e2a9c6`

item.title: Typefield 0.59.24
item.description:
Typefield now checks for published updates automatically. Open Settings → Updates or Typefield → Check for Updates to check manually. Automatic downloading and installation are optional.
This release also includes the latest Spaces tools, alignment guides and effects, plus improved Letterform Line, Pen and path construction. Your saved fonts, library and projects stay in place.
Existing copies without an Updates page need one manual download from typefield.app to enable future in-app updates.
